maddeler.e:
نهتجر (form VIII)
# نَهْتَجِرُ (nahtajiru) /nah.ta.d͡ʒi.ru/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِهْتَجَرَ (ihtajara)
# نَهْتَجِرَ (nahtajira) /nah.ta.d͡ʒi.ra/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِهْتَجَرَ (ihtajara)
# نَهْتَجِرْ (nahtajir) /nah.ta.d͡ʒir/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِهْتَجَرَ (ihtajara)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
